$comment: Phase 0.4 Full-tier embedder task-set. Locks the three-way pool (4B-Q8 incumbent vs 8B-Q6_K challenger_upsize vs 0.6B-Q8 challenger_downsize), all on llama.cpp CPU per ADR-0017 amend #3. Two retrieval blocks (code + docs), 20 queries per block = 40 queries total. Two chunking strategies (H1 fixed 512+64, H2 symbol/section-aware with H1 fallback) as sub-cells. Metrics: nDCG@10, Recall@10, MRR@10, Recall@1. Graded 0-3 relevance with primary/secondary flag; primary defined at source-file + line-range level (chunker-agnostic per P1). Gold labels produced by Perplexity-Max on pooled union-of-top-20 per query across all cells. Reversal criteria V3+W3 pre-locked. post_hoc_edit_locked flips to true on ADR-0030 Ratification (fixture lock-in). Authored 2026-08-11 13:05 EDT.
post_hoc_edit_lockin_trigger: ADR-0030 status flip Proposed→Ratified upon fixture lock-in
candidates_amendment_note: Amended 2026-08-11 15:00 EDT: enomicc_q6k_gpu (nomic-embed-code Q6_K) added as sanity_check_crossfamily. Not in reversal scope. See candidate_pool.enomicc_q6k_gpu.reversal_participation=false.

co_residency_contract.rationale: Coder (qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct-awq-4bit vLLM GPU per ADR-0029) + planner (qwen3_6-27b-q6k-gguf llama.cpp GPU per ADR-0025) together saturate VRAM in production. Embedder must not compete. All 3 candidates run llama.cpp CPU. RAM peak per cell ≤ 8 GiB (8B-Q6_K weights 5.79 GiB + KV + overhead) — well within 128 GiB Colossus RAM.
co_residency_contract.harness_enforcement: runner must pass -ngl 0 to llama.cpp for every embedder cell

corpus.notes: Corpus is 3 real project repositories at pinned commit SHAs. Distractors are natural (production code plus tests, adapters, dead-code paths).

blocks.query_authoring_notes: Queries are natural intents a coding agent would issue: 'find the function that computes X', 'where is Y adapter registered', 'which module implements Z protocol'. Query set is authored blind to the corpus (no chunk-peeking); queries answerable only via chunk semantics not filename matching are preferred.

Spec-lookup intents: 'which ADR set the coder role', 'what does ADR-0007 say about R2 warnings', 'find the section of Kosmos spec that defines MemoryPort'. Preference for queries that require semantic matching (e.g. paraphrased ADR titles), not exact-title lookup.

code_strategy.primary: per-symbol via ast.parse (function-level + class-level; each method its own chunk; module docstring one chunk)
code_strategy.fallback: H1_fixed_512_64 for files where ast.parse fails or produces >1024-token symbols (split symbol into fixed chunks)

docs_strategy.primary: per-heading (## and ### as chunk boundaries; each heading section is one chunk)

cell_matrix.shape: 3 candidates x 2 chunkers x 2 blocks = 12 cells

primary_gold_key_rule.definition: primary gold hit is defined at (repo, source_file_path, line_range) tuple. A retrieved chunk counts as MRR@1 hit if its (source_file_path, line_span) intersects the labeled primary line_range. Chunker-agnostic: same qrel file is used for both H1 and H2 sub-cells within a block.

gold_labeling.pool_composition: For each query, union the top-20 chunks (by embedder similarity score) across ALL 12 cells. Deduplicate at (repo, source_file_path, line_range) key. Label each unique (repo, file, line_range) once.

grading_scale.1: marginal (touches topic but does not answer query)
grading_scale.3: exact (contains the specific fact/function/decision the query asks about)

per_query.primary_definition: the single most-canonical (file, line_range) that best answers the query; used as the MRR@1 target

gold_labeling.labeling_locked_at: before first embedder inference on any candidate

metrics.per_block_reporting: Composite AND all 4 components reported per (candidate, chunker, block). Cell-level macros = mean across queries within cell.
metrics.candidate_block_macro: mean of composite across the 2 chunker sub-cells for that (candidate, block).
metrics.candidate_overall_macro: mean of composite across all 4 (chunker × block) sub-cells for that candidate.

reversal_criteria.note: Boundary values default to preserving incumbent (confirms 4B-Q8). Post-hoc interpretation prohibited.
confirm_incumbent_4b_q8_if: AT LEAST ONE OF THESE HOLDS AT SCORING TIME:
1. 4B composite candidate_overall_macro >= (max of challenger overall_macros) - 3.0 (within tiebreak band; incumbent retained on tie)
2. On the code block, no challenger passes W3 strict gate (defined below)
3. On the docs block, no challenger passes W3 strict gate (defined below)
flip_to_8b_q6k_if: 1. 8B block-macro on code >= 4B block-macro on code + 3.0 (W1)
2. 8B block-macro on docs >= 4B block-macro on docs + 3.0 (W1)
3. On code block AND docs block: no per-metric regression from 4B > 5.0 points (W2)
4. On code block AND docs block: no per-metric loss from 4B > 2.0 points on any of {nDCG10, Recall10, MRR10, Recall1} (W3)
5. RAM peak of 8B-Q6_K on either block <= 12 GiB (co-residency safety guard)
flip_to_0_6b_q8_if: 1. 0.6B block-macro on code >= 4B block-macro on code + 3.0 (W1)
2. 0.6B block-macro on docs >= 4B block-macro on docs + 3.0 (W1)
3. On code block AND docs block: no per-metric regression from 4B > 5.0 points (W2)
4. On code block AND docs block: no per-metric loss from 4B > 2.0 points on any of {nDCG10, Recall10, MRR10, Recall1} (W3)
5. 0.6B frees at least 3.0 GiB RAM headroom vs 4B AND wall-time speedup >= 2x (headroom/speed justification for a downsize)
reversal_criteria.intermediate_if_neither_confirm_nor_flip: If confirm_incumbent conditions fail on BOTH blocks AND no challenger passes its full W3 gate on BOTH blocks, verdict is INTERMEDIATE and a per-block role split may be proposed in the verdict ADR (e.g. 8B for docs, 4B for code) — such a split requires its own follow-up ADR.
reversal_criteria.tiebreak: Wall-time median per query, applied ONLY within a 3-point composite band on the winning block(s). Speed cannot flip a tie in favor of a challenger against incumbent (incumbent wins ties).

harness_contract.index: flat cosine similarity (no ANN/FAISS at Full-tier; exact search)
harness_contract.runtime_env_note: coder vLLM and planner llama.cpp GPU processes MUST be stopped before running each embedder cell (VRAM is not needed but process contention on CPU cores would skew wall-time). Runner enforces via systemctl stop / docker stop.

definition_of_done_gate_4: 1. bench/candidates/embedder-full-pool.json committed with all 3 candidates + weight_bytes + role_designation (DONE at ADR-0030 Proposed)
2. bench/tasks/embedder-full-multi-block.json committed with pre-locked reversal criteria (DONE at ADR-0030 Proposed)
3. Corpus manifest committed: repo snapshot SHAs pinned; file lists frozen; total chunk count reported for both H1 and H2 (blocks BOTH steps)
4. Query set committed: 40 queries authored blind to corpus indexes; queries frozen
5. Rubric committed at bench/rubrics/full-embedder-scored.json with post_hoc_edit_locked=true after step 4
6. Gold qrels labeled by Perplexity-Max over pooled union-of-top-20 and locked with sha256 file
7. All 12 cells inference-run under harness; per-cell top-20 retrieval saved to bench/scoring/full-embedder/runs/
8. Composite + component metrics computed per cell; per-block macros computed
9. Reversal criteria applied mechanically; verdict ADR-0031 filed
